# ChartNav Current Product Truth

Date: 2026-05-19
Purpose: one source of truth for what ChartNav currently is, what is demo-only or production-gated, and what must not be claimed.

## Hard Safety Statements

- `deterministic_stub` remains the default for LLM workflows.
- The OpenAI adapter is fake-data/demo-only.
- No production LLM is approved.
- No real PHI should use fake-data/demo adapters.
- Fundus charting is clinician-entered findings to structured drawing support.
- Fundus charting is not image interpretation.
- Fundus charting is not diagnosis.
- Ambient documentation assist (Phase 57) is provider-reviewed transcript-to-draft support only.
- Ambient documentation assist is not hands-free scribing.
- Ambient documentation assist is not autonomous documentation.
- Ambient documentation assist does not place orders, refer, message patients, bill, or code.
- Technician Workup & Structured Vitals is technician-entered or clinician-entered intake for provider review.
- Technician Workup & Structured Vitals is not diagnosis, treatment recommendation, device integration, remote patient monitoring, ordering, referral, patient messaging, billing, or coding.
- IBM watsonx fake-data live eval has passed in a manual-only smoke test, but watsonx remains blocked for real-PHI, pilot, and production use.
- ChartNav is not a certified EHR.
- ChartNav does not replace a certified EHR.

## Release Use

Before a PR changes clinical workflows, public copy, demo scripts, vendor seams, runtime config, or security docs, update this file if the capability status, gate, claim posture, or rollback path changed. If this file and the implementation disagree, treat this file as a release blocker and reconcile before merging.
